info.title: Carevanta API
info.description: Carevanta healthcare marketplace API. All monetary values are integer minor units (paise) with an ISO-4217 currency code. List endpoints use cursor pagination. Retryable POSTs marked "Idempotency-Key required" must send a unique key per logical operation.

get.description:
Positive = owed to the provider; negative = the provider owes commission (e.g. pay-at-counter bookings).

post.description:
Returns the gateway order for the checkout SDK. Payment is confirmed only by the gateway webhook, never by the app.

**Idempotency-Key header required.**

post.summary: Record money received outside the gateway (platform account or at the provider)
post.description:
receivedBy=PLATFORM captures a MANUAL payment (amount ≤ due); when fully paid the transaction becomes PAID and, if already completed, the provider earning is posted. receivedBy=PROVIDER marks the transaction PAY_AT_PROVIDER (no money held by the platform). Every call is audited with the reason.

**Required permissions:** finance.manual.record

post.summary: Close an abandoned online checkout (CREATED → FAILED)
Record a refund paid to the patient outside the gateway
post.description:
Allowed for REQUESTED (recorder acts as approver, must differ from requester), APPROVED and FAILED refunds. Applies the same ledger clawback and commission recalculation as a gateway webhook.

**Required permissions:** finance.manual.record

post.summary: Post a manual ledger adjustment for a provider
post.description:
Positive = owed to the provider (credit), negative = owed by the provider (debit). Capped at ₹10,00,000 per entry; append-only, so corrections are made with an opposite entry.

**Required permissions:** finance.manual.record
